company_name: Su Zhou Precision Test Tech. Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Su Zhou Precision Test Tech. Ltd. specializes in semiconductor testing interface services and products, making it a key player in the testing segment of the semiconductor industry.
summary: Established in Suzhou Industrial Park in 2019, Su Zhou Precision Test Tech. Ltd. provides semiconductor testing interface services with an 'All-In-House' business model. The company offers a range of products including wafer-level test probe cards and chip test carriers, leveraging proprietary probe technology to meet diverse testing needs.
